content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Jangaon District Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://jangaon.telangana.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 14-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Jangaon District Cook and Kamati recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of applications for the Jangaon District Cook and Kamati recruitment is 14th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Cook post?
faq.answer: For the Cook post, candidates need to have cooking experience and the ability to read and write. Specific details can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Jangaon District recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 46 years for all posts. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Kamati post?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies available for the Kamati post in the Jangaon District recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Cook and Kamati posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 11,700/- to Rs. 15,600/- per month, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Written Examination followed by the preparation of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the Jangaon District recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for Jangaon District recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for Jangaon District recruitment is https://jangaon.telangana.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 06-01/2026.
